name: How long does a multi-room renovation take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a multi-room renovation take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline usually ranges from several weeks for smaller room combinations to several months for a larger interior renovation. Projects that involve multiple connected spaces, custom cabinetry, or design changes typically take longer because decisions, ordering, and construction all affect one another.
acceptedAnswer.description: Smaller multi-room updates may take weeks, while larger renovations can take several months. The more rooms and custom details involved, the longer the schedule usually becomes.
